result.analyst_notes: Factual, confident tone centered on customer value and the off-price model, with several 'we believe' and 'we are convinced' statements. Customers are addressed first; the employee and sustainability commitments are brief and generic. Wording is first-person plural and mostly declarative, with a sustainability pledge stated without specifics.
